question: Should this protected CI-cache rollout merge with immediate post-merge verification of the first v2 protected warm-cache consumer?
rationale: The branch supplies after-fix cold-transition evidence, but the protected cache trust boundary prevents proving the exact v2 warm-hit path from a pull request before merge.

options.title: Merge with rollout monitoring
